notes.title: Update 1.07
notes.notes:
Several updates has been released since release with following improvements.
[list]
[*]Scale UI (MouseWheel with LeftAlt, or LeftALt+LeftShift)
[*]Move map (mouse drag)
[*]Translation to Hungarian (thanks to Zsolt Brechler)
[*]Combo Hint is showing over enemy in scene
[*]Mapping keyboard
[*]In-game help (F1)
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27836980/d4349939e5aba38bf1cca7d23859bd188712a3ca.png[/img]

notes.title: The Keep Contest
notes.notes:
To celebrate the release of The Keep we are starting a contest. Who will first finish game and collect all 25 achievements will a unique handcrafted Watrys figure. Which has been designed, molded and painted by developers of The Keep. We created only five pieces of those.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27836980/94f28e6545d7a3182232605edea8a77918b93721.png[/img]

More information: http://steamcommunity.com/app/317370/discussions/0/133259956003721100/

notes.title: Trailer and release date
notes.notes:
We are proud to announce that The Keep, an old-school first person dungeon crawler with real-time combat is set to be released on 16th March 2017.

https://youtu.be/N16I3zEMfP4

[b]Enter The Keep on March 16![/b]
